body.p:
The tortoise told the bumblebee: "You dini bees, tcinde bees, xom-dini bees and tcʼipa bees. You must all come together then I must tell you." Thus he told. Then the bumblebee refused. "I am old and you are also an elder. You cannot tell me [what to do]. I refuse." Thus [the bumblebee] spoke and went away. Then [the tortoise] told the dini bee and the tcinde bee: "Dini bee, you settle down in the big tree hole and build an opening.
Then when you collect tree blossoms, you enter there in the opening and then you produce children, and you also produce grease. I told the tcʼipa bee like that. "Tcʼipa bee, you settle down and build a house in the big tree hole with your breed." "Tcinde bee, you settle down like that in a good tree hole, you collect tree blossoms, and then you enter the homestead." With the tortoise telling like that, the tcinde bee settled down in a good tree hole, collected blossoms and kept-producing offspring. Like that it told the xom-dini bee. Tortoise: "Xom-dini bee, you yourself dig in the soil. Then you dig deeply, reach, and then you build your homestead. Then you collect tree blossoms, enter the homestead and keep producing children." These are the words which the tortoise was saying. The ones who did it like that, they did well. The bumblebee ignored it. The tortoise assembled in order to tell. Then: "Because it did like that, it is without a homestead in a bad
condition." The ones whom the tortoise told, they were doing well. As it happened like that, dini bees, xom-dini bees, tcinde bees and tcʼipa bees were with honey. Then they became many as the tortoise said. The bumblebee who had refused was bad and without honey. Thus they behaved with each other. This is the fairy tale of the tortoise.
